'''''Phlebodium''''' is a small genus of [[fern]]s in the family [[Polypodiaceae]], subfamily [[Polypodioideae]], according to the [[Pteridophyte Phylogeny Group]] classification of 2016 (PPG I).<ref name=PPGI/> It is native to tropical and subtropical regions of the [[Americas]].<ref name=ferns>Ferns of the World: [http://homepages.caverock.net.nz/~bj/fern/phlebodium.htm ''Phlebodium''] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081017045503/http://homepages.caverock.net.nz/~bj/fern/phlebodium.htm |date=2008-10-17 }}</ref><ref name=fna>Flora of North America: [http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=125032 ''Phlebodium'']</ref><ref name=grin>Germplasm Resources Information Network: {{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20121211202307/http://www.ars-grin.gov/cgi-bin/npgs/html/splist.pl?9254|title=''Phlebodium''}}</ref> Its species were formerly included in ''[[Polypodium]]''.<ref name=grin/>

They are [[epiphyte|epiphytic]] ferns, with a creeping, densely hairy or scaly [[rhizome]] bearing [[frond]]s at intervals along its length. The fronds are evergreen, persisting for 1–2 years, and are pinnatifid. The [[sorus|sori]] or groups of spore-cases ([[Sporangium|sporangia]]) are borne on the back of the frond.<ref name=fna/>
